findings.rule: Every application-owned parent/global dependency used by a business module must be declared by its manifest-bound runtime contract.
findings.title: Parent/global dependency census

findings.rule: An application-owned shared asset consumed by at least three modules must be referenced by a test path or basename; vendor fan-out is informational.
findings.title: Shared application asset fan-out

findings.notes: External absolute paths and template placeholders are not treated as repository-path claims; explicitly historical sections are excluded.
findings.rule: Every repository path cited by a current-authority scope must resolve in the audited snapshot.
findings.title: Current-authority cited paths resolve

findings.notes: Starting SHAs, superseded decision-register sections, prior APK evidence and explicitly historical sections are excluded from present-state comparison.
findings.rule: Typed present-state claims among current-authority scopes must not assign different values to the same fact.
findings.title: Current-authority contradictions

findings.notes: Bodies are line-ending-normalized and trimmed; names and parameter lists are intentionally outside the body comparison.
findings.rule: A function body of at least 160 LF-normalized characters must not be byte-identical across three or more product files.
findings.title: Byte-identical repeated function bodies

findings.notes: Similarity is multiset Dice similarity over ordered five-token shingles, preserving local control-flow order while normalizing identifiers and literals; SHA-256 identities are emitted for each cluster.
findings.rule: After comment/whitespace removal and identifier/literal normalization, bodies of at least 240 normalized characters with at least 90% ordered five-token-shingle similarity must not span three or more product files.
findings.title: Near-copy function bodies

findings.rule: An identical CSS declaration block containing at least six declarations must not appear in three or more module files.
findings.title: Repeated CSS declaration blocks

findings.notes: Literal values are fingerprinted rather than emitted. Ordinary use sites are excluded; only uppercase domain-definition sites are counted.
findings.rule: The same named domain constant and literal value must not be defined as an authority in two or more product files.
findings.title: Duplicated approved domain constants

findings.notes: Persistent key names are represented by one-way concept IDs; manifest shared assets use the module manifest as their declared authority.
findings.rule: Each application-owned asset or persistent-key concept shared by at least two modules must have exactly one declared product authority.
findings.title: Single authority for shared concepts

findings.rule: A module using persistent or device storage must enter through the manifest-bound shared storage gateway
findings.title: Declared storage/device gateway enforcement

findings.notes: Absence of a token is not called divergence; this check compares only definitions of the canonical shared names.
findings.rule: Every definition of a shared SAAGAR design token must equal its canonical normalized value.
findings.title: Shared design-token divergence

findings.notes: Evidence stores only source location, kind and a one-way text fingerprint; rendered/dynamic completeness is decided by A6-05.
findings.rule: Static text on controls, control labels, accessibility attributes, literal notification calls and first-party shared JavaScript DOM-label sinks must be covered by the shared localization dictionary unless it is business data, a proper name or an approved technical label.
findings.title: Static localization bypass

findings.rule: A definite undeclared parent/global contract use is P1; heuristic absence is unmeasured, never pass, because alias and computed access can evade the scan
findings.title: Declared parent and global contracts

findings.notes: Names such as token, SaagarExportControl or beginDelivery do not authorize a sink unless the control is invoked and denial returns or throws before delivery.
findings.rule: Every reachable download, print, popup, browser share or native share delivery must have a structural fail-closed begin-delivery guard, or be a helper whose every call site has that guard.
findings.title: Export policy bypass

findings.rule: An authentication, authorization or PIN control must deny when its required control is absent or throws.
findings.title: Fail-open authentication and PIN controls

findings.notes: Every unresolved dynamic target is a fail-closed policy violation until it is structurally resolved.
findings.rule: Shipped runtime must not contain a reachable literal external request, remote asset, navigation or message target outside approved contexts; dynamic targets must be resolved before pass.
findings.title: Unapproved remote runtime behavior

findings.rule: Tracked centralized identity consumers and both runner-generated Android receipts must agree on package, version, minimum SDK and generated source identities.
findings.title: Version and build identity agreement
